Fixtures for the checks (scripts/browser-check.mjs), served by the dev server and never built into the site.

- `whoosh.scsyndef` and `whoosh.json`: a user's synth with its metadata (Sonic Pi's beep synthdef, renamed). The
  metadata is the format each built-in synth is written out in (web/data/synth-meta.json).
- `plain.scsyndef`: the same synthdef with no metadata, for the page made from its controls alone.
